description: Fictional, vendor-neutral skills an agent would plausibly also have installed. They are listed next to the suite's skills in routing evals, indistinguishable in format, to test whether descriptions still win against realistic neighbours. A routing case may expect a distractor when it is the right tool; that means 'not one of our skills'.

skills.name: user-research-planning
skills.description: Plans and runs user research: research questions, interview guides, recruiting screeners, usability tests, and synthesis of interview notes into themes and insights. Use for discovery research, customer or employee interviews, and turning raw research into findings.

skills.name: process-mapping
skills.description: Documents business processes as BPMN 2.0 or swimlane diagrams with steps, roles, gateways, systems, and handoffs, and identifies bottlenecks and waste. Use when asked to map, document, standardize, or optimize an operational, back-office, or onboarding process.

skills.name: okr-planning
skills.description: Drafts objectives and key results for teams and companies, checks that key results are measurable outcomes rather than tasks, and aligns OKRs across levels. Use for quarterly planning, goal setting, and OKR reviews.

skills.name: product-roadmapping
skills.description: Builds product roadmaps from goals, themes, and a backlog: now/next/later views, sequencing, dependencies, and stakeholder-ready roadmap narratives. Use when planning what to build and in what order over the coming quarters.

skills.name: survey-design
skills.description: Designs customer and employee surveys such as NPS, CSAT, CES, and eNPS: question wording, scales, sampling, follow-up questions, and bias checks. Use when writing or reviewing a questionnaire or feedback survey.

skills.name: persona-creation
skills.description: Creates user or buyer personas with goals, needs, pain points, behaviours, and quotes for marketing, product, or design teams. Use when a team asks for personas, customer profiles, or archetypes.

skills.name: workshop-facilitation
skills.description: Designs and facilitates workshops, offsites, retrospectives, and brainstorming sessions: agendas, timings, exercises, icebreakers, and decision-making techniques. Use when a team needs to plan or run any collaborative session.

skills.name: kpi-dashboard-builder
skills.description: Designs KPI dashboards and reports: selects metrics, defines calculations, sets targets and thresholds, and lays out charts for executives or operational teams. Use when building or improving a dashboard or metrics report.

skills.name: change-communications
skills.description: Plans and writes change-management communications: announcements, FAQs, manager talking points, stakeholder maps, and rollout timelines for organizational or system changes. Use when employees or customers must be informed about a change.

skills.name: hr-onboarding-checklist
skills.description: Creates new-hire onboarding checklists and schedules covering paperwork, accounts, equipment, training, and first-week and first-90-day tasks for HR and managers. Use when setting up or improving an employee onboarding program.

skills.name: support-macro-writer
skills.description: Writes customer support macros, canned responses, and help-center articles with the right tone, troubleshooting steps, and escalation paths. Use when support agents need reply templates or knowledge-base content.

skills.name: incident-postmortem
skills.description: Writes blameless incident postmortems for outages and production incidents: timeline, impact, root cause analysis, contributing factors, and action items. Use after an outage, SLA breach, or operational incident.

skills.name: itsm-service-desk
skills.description: Designs IT service management for internal service desks: ticket categories, queues, SLAs, request fulfilment, incident and problem management, and service catalogs. Use when setting up or improving an IT or HR service desk.

skills.name: design-critique
skills.description: Critiques UI and visual designs, prototypes, and design deliverables for hierarchy, consistency, accessibility, usability heuristics, and visual polish, with prioritized feedback. Use when reviewing a mockup, screen, or design artifact.
